title: The Transfer That Charges Twice
description: Retried payment transfers debit accounts twice and rejected transfers leave balances inconsistent.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: Ledger stores nonnegative integer cent balances. transfer(key,source,target,cents) validates a positive amount, distinct existing accounts, sufficient funds and a nonempty key. Replaying the identical key/request has no effect; conflicting reuse throws. Failed requests change neither balances nor replay keys. C++ exposes Ledger.balances as map<string,long long>.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
